capabilities: Convert pasted URLs into titled Markdown links
Save pasted images to the attachments folder with clean filenames
Convert pasted HTML into clean Markdown
Replace YouTube and Twitter links with their titles
Toggle each paste transform and customize filename templates in settings
extras: Part of a 'Plus Plugin Family' with Vault Plus and Link Plus by the same author. README notes the plugin was awaiting community directory approval at time of writing.
motivation: The author wanted to unify a dozen single-purpose paste plugins into one zero-configuration plugin covering the most common paste scenarios.
problem: Obsidian's default paste inserts raw URLs, unclean HTML, and generically named images, forcing manual cleanup after each paste.
summary: Paste enhancer that turns pasted URLs, images, HTML, YouTube and Twitter links into clean Markdown automatically.
